platforms/net.py: detect_manifest ranks a project over a property file, an application, or a test project by what it declares (OutputType, IsTestProject/IsPackable, a test-runner PackageReference), not by depth; a namespace is now a public_symbol (SurfaceExtractor's _namespaces); the framework floor is read from the manifest the plugin names, not the vendored reader's own shallowest-file guess; a dependency snapshot comes from PackageReference, splitting required from a PrivateAssets/ExcludeAssets development bucket

platforms/net_examples.py: the wrapper targets the SDK it found, never the package's declared floor; every diagnostic is scrubbed of this machine's workspace path and MSBuild's own non-reproducible Time Elapsed line; -p:WarningLevel=0 silences the referenced product's own warnings, whose count and order are not stable between builds; a workspace Windows will not release falls back through up to five disposable directories before reporting BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN rather than crashing
evidence/facts/links.py: a link whose HEAD answer would condemn it is confirmed with a GET before being called MISSING (nuget.org answers HEAD 404, GET 200)

reconciliation/dispositions.py: a placement into a section whose condition is false, or that renders no evidence at all, is deferred rather than asked for a second time; a command block cited only by an install fact is never routed to development_testing without checking that section's own condition

composition/planning.py: shared_fact_ids is composed from the citations rather than asked for and rejected when incomplete; a link naming a shell-owned fact (product.banner/homepage/enterprise) is excluded from the schema's own enum, not merely rejected at runtime

review/independent/review.py: a quote is checked character for character with an ellipsis between exact fragments, never a paraphrase; an omission finding backed by a non-SUPPORTED fact_id is the reviewer's own defect whether or not the quote itself names that fact
